content.name: Boso Ta - Alien Voice (German audio)
content.description: Replaces Boso Ta's German voice lines (voice set 10201) with processed copies: one octave down with shifted formants, frequency shift and chorus. Timing and lip sync unchanged. Audio is built locally with tools/process_audio.py and is not part of the repository.
